name: humanmade/hm-abilities-mcp
description: Registers a set of WordPress Abilities API entries (whoami, content CRUD, media sideload, navigation, settings read/write, block helpers) flagged for exposure over MCP.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS and PHPStan over the plugin.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Auto-fix the coding standard violations that are fixable.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run static analysis at PHPStan level 5.
